title: X
overview: After his teammates leave, amateur Blader Robin Kazami has no choice but to join the mysterious Blader X.

title: Multi-Colored Ambush
overview: After revealing his true identity and forming Team Persona with Robin, Jaxon signs the new team up for a pro-selection match.

title: Team Persona
overview: After their battle with the mega-popular Multi Nana-iro, Jaxon set his sights on a potential third member for Team Persona.

title: Bey Sponsor
overview: Now that they're officially pros, the hunt is on for Team Persona's Bey Sponsor, who will help them train and climb The X.

title: To The X
overview: Now that Team Persona is officially sponsored by Komaba Sushi, the team is finally ready to battle at The X.

title: Lion's Jungle
overview: Instead of training, Robin, Jaxon, and Multi set off to Lion's Jungle to scout out their opponents, Team Zooganic, and see if they could gather any intel.

title: Team Zooganic
overview: It's Team Persona's debut match, and they're set to go head-to-head with the inimitable Team Zooganic.

title: The Mask and the King
overview: The Persona-Zooganic showdown is locked at one point each. It has all come down to Jaxon's battle with Zooganic's leader, Titus Manju.

title: Beycrafter
overview: After their victory against Team Zooganic, Multi uses some Beycrafting skills to help Robin improve his game.

title: The Pro Realm
overview: Team Phalanx is hanging on to their sponsorship by a thread. Their upcoming match with Team Persona is their last chance to stay in the limelight.

title: Warden's Exam
overview: After failing Warden's Exam, Robin wonders if he can ever get to the same level as his teammates.

title: The Final Battle
overview: Team Persona enters the Solo Battle Fest, a series of exhibition matches.

title: The First Fan
overview: With all eyes on Blader X and Multi Nana-iro, Robin finds his first fan.

title: Jax-ercise
overview: Ms. Myoden informs everyone that a new Blader has broken Jaxon's record.

title: Riddles and Beys
overview: At Zonamos House Bladers can not only battle but also solve riddles

title: Noblesse Oblige
overview: Team Persona have just one riddle left to solve!

title: Bey Timeshift
overview: A mysterious Bey has been distributed all over the city.

title: Pride
overview: After switching their Beys, Team Phalanx is on a winning streak.

title: Zip and Zoom
overview: Team Persona is a guest at Zip and Zoom.

title: Memories of Sushi
overview: Team Persona have to raise Robin's popularity with fans.

title: Pop Production
overview: Multi helps Jaxon and Robin up their fashion game.

title: Black and White
overview: Team Persona’s match against Yggdrasil is here!

title: True Heart
overview: Blaze is nowhere to be seen at the second battle of the Persona-Yggdrasil match.

title: Arrival of the Fastest
overview: Blaze Fujiwara finally arrives at the match.

title: Proof of the Fastest
overview: The battle to determine the team's results for the Persona-Yggdrasil match has begun.

title: Invitation
overview: The Shuffle Battle Fest, an event where B4 breaks existing teams apart and creates a new group of teams, will be held.

title: The End of Persistence
overview: Takumi is holding Bey battles against multiple amateurs for some reason.

title: The King and the Phoenix
overview: The Shuffle Battle Fest has finally begun! In this event, previously unimagined teams clashed from the very first match.

title: Mask and Meat Buns
overview: The Battle between Blader X and Jian begins. Titus tells Mr. Taisho how he met the Zooganic members and what makes them strong.

title: Riddles and Pop
overview: The Shuffle Battle Fest continues, and Multi's team, Multi and Me, goes up against Top Boyz.

title: My Teammates
overview: The match between Team Multi and Me and Team Top Boyz enters its final battle.

title: New Partner
overview: The last day of the Shuffle Battle Fest has arrived, and Robin's team, Found Family, is ready for battle.

title: Our Promise
overview: It's the Found Family's final battle and time for Meiko Myoden to take the stage.

title: A Rainbow Guest
overview: Jaxon and Robin are helping out at Komaba Sushi when Sigrid Nana-iro comes looking for something to eat.

title: The Dream Contest
overview: Now that the Shuffle Battle Fest voting polls have closed, the All-Star Battle is set to begin!

title: Bladership
overview: Robin loses in the All-Star to Packu, Multi picks up where he left off.

title: Unpredictable
overview: The second Blader for the dreams is the unpredictable Rex Jura.

title: Return of the Queen
overview: It's time for the living legend, Quinn Manju, to take the stage.

title: The Greatest Blader
overview: The final clash of the All-Star Battle is underway.

title: The Other Mask
overview: Someone calling themselves Blader Y appears in Xenon City, battling Pro Bladers.

title: The Three Masks
overview: Blader Y’s not the only masked stranger hunting pros.

title: XYZ
overview: It’s up to Robin to come up with a plot to lure out these troublesome masked Bladers.

title: Pendragon, Back Then
overview: This is a story of how Team Pendragon used to be.

title: Family, Back Then
overview: Multi tells Robin about the history of his Bey, Scythe Incendio.

title: You, Back Then
overview: A young Blader arrives in Xenon City, full of dreams.

title: Time Off
overview: Robin heads back to his hometown with Jaxon before the title match.

title: Battle at the Top
overview: At last, it’s Team Persona’s battle against Team Pendragon.

title: The Nana-iro Showdown
overview: Multi goes up against Sigrid Nana-iro in the first battle of the title match.

title: Something Xtraordinary
overview: Pendragon’s second Blader is Khrome Ryugu; it's Blader X's turn to take the stage.

title: The Two Xs
overview: After a head-on collision cracks Buster Dran, Khrome reflects on his time with Jaxon.

title: The Most Fun Ever
overview: In the final battle, Blader Z seeks revenge while Robin is cheered on by his teammates.

title: Restart
overview: They might have lost, but Team Persona still has their sights set on the top of The X.

title: Signs of a New Era
overview: Zooganic and Yggdrasil are likely candidates to be contenders in the next Title Match.

title: Path of Resolve
overview: With Khrome missing, Team Pendragon is not allowed to battle in an official match.

title: Advance Bey Timeshift
overview: Takumi's visit to Yggdrasil Research is interrupted by Karla Konjiki.

title: Star Plot
overview: Tenka Shiroboshi appears at Komaba Sushi, demanding a battle with Blader X.

title: Tri-Blader Battle
overview: Finally, Team Persona's next match has been set against not one but two teams!

title: Triple Battle
overview: When Zonamos passes on an opportunity to pose a riddle, Multi knows something is up!

title: Blader S
overview: With Blader X indisposed, a new Blader helps Team Persona: the mysterious Blader S!

title: The Multi-Coloured Trial
overview: Blaze, Zonamos, and Yuni go to a remote Yggdrasil Research lab when a guest arrives!

title: Invincible
overview: At last, Blader X takes on Tenka.

title: The Prestigious Bey Academy
overview: Multi visits the prestigious Bey academy to ask an old mentor for help.

title: The Manju Clan
overview: On the quest to learn more about Beycrafting, Multi visits the home of the Manju Clan.

title: The Shapeless Shadow
overview: While chatting with Joka, Multi expresses feelings of anxiety towards this ‘new era’.

title: First Flight
overview: When Tenka asks Robin what made him start Blading, he reminisces about his old friend.

title: Something Captivating
overview: Robin wants to give Tsubasa advice, but he needs to prove his strength as a Blader.

title: Silver Wolf
overview: Packun shares a rumour that could upend the Blading world!

title: Light and Dark
overview: Ginro invites Jaxon to join the fight to save the world from the Shadow Pros.

title: Shadowy Underground
overview: Ginro and the others try to rescue Packun from the Shadow Pros.

title: Dread Dragon
overview: Byte appears and tempts Ciel with the power of the ‘Dread Dragon’.

title: To That Place
overview: Khrome has been missing but now he’s come face to face with Omega Shiroboshi.

title: Labyrinth of Riddles and Terror
overview: Zonamos House hosts an event where fans get to battle Blader X…if they can solve riddles!

title: The Star Battle
overview: The Star Battle begins: Pro and Amateur Bladers launch into battle.

title: Cursed
overview: When Persona meets with Gordias, their first battle is between each team's leader.

title: Return of the Knight
overview: Multi completes an epic Beycrafting journey and returns to Team Persona with a new Bey!

title: The Path of the Demon Dragon
The Fox's Seven Forms, The Tanuki's Eight Forms
The X That Devours The Stars
Destruction
overview: The Persona fan meeting is a huge success. As rumors of a pro blader hunt spread, the identity of the 100th challenger in the challenge battle becomes clear...!?

title: The Second X
overview: The Persona group rushes outside after experiencing a violent tremor, only to be shocked by a sight. Furthermore, a giant hologram of Kurosu Zero declares that Beyblade is doomed...

title: The End of the Demon Dragon
